responsibility: This generator turns legacy DEFINE_PEEPHOLE patterns into the peephole function that scans short RTL insn sequences and replaces matched sequences with a synthetic PARALLEL carrying extracted operands. It emits explicit runtime matching code over NEXT_INSN/PATTERN structure, operand predicates, equality checks, and extra C conditions, then rewrites the first insn with the matched operands, assigns the peephole’s insn code, and deletes the remaining matched insns for later extraction and output handling.
